g.title: Sheet.161
g.desc: TCP doesn't know the available bandwidth between the sender a...
g.text: TCP doesn't know the available bandwidth between the sender and receiver. It begins by sending a small amount of data, usually one segment.

g.title: Sheet.163
g.desc: For every acknowledgment received from the receiver, the amou...
g.text: For every acknowledgment received from the receiver, the amount of data sent is doubled.

g.title: Sheet.166
g.desc: This causes the data flow to grow exponentially during the in...
g.text: This causes the data flow to grow exponentially during the initial phase, allowing TCP to quickly ramp up to the network's capacity.
